web.stack: Vue 3.5, vue-router 4, pinia 3, vite 6, vitest 3, happy-dom, @vue/test-utils, vue-tsc

dirs.components: subfolders album/, forms/, profile/, crate/ plus top-level LibraryToolbar.vue
dirs.views: CrateView, CratesView, LibraryView, AlbumView, AlbumEditorView, LoginView, SignupView, ProfileView, EditProfileView, NotFoundView

web.router: exports `router` (createWebHistory); lazy views for most routes; meta.requiresAuth augmented via declare module; guard uses session store

tests.framework: vitest run, environment happy-dom (configured in apps/web/vite.config.ts test block)
tests.appVueMount: App.test.ts: createPinia()+setActivePinia, createRouter with createMemoryHistory and Blank stub routes, await router.push('/') and isReady, mount(App, {global:{plugins:[pinia, router]}}), flushPromises; fetch stubbed with vi.stubGlobal
tests.routerTest: router.test.ts: imports real `router`, setActivePinia(createPinia()) per test, vi.mock('./api/auth.ts'), asserts router.currentRoute after router.push

conventions.vue: All SFCs use <script setup lang="ts"> then <template> then <style scoped> (28 of 30 have scoped style; EmptyShelf.vue and NotFoundView.vue have none). No unscoped component styles.
conventions.global_css: Single file apps/web/src/styles/base.css, imported in main.ts. No fonts loaded (no @font-face, no link in index.html).

tokens.note: No spacing/radius/shadow tokens. 25 raw hex literals remain in .vue files.

conventions.base_rules: box-sizing reset; body paper bg, ink text, font-body, line-height 1.5; a{color:inherit}; button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}; inputs flat (border 1px ink-soft, radius 0); .sr-only; .status-note; view-transition animation rules.
conventions.buttons_links: Global .btn class (display font, ink bg, paper text, no border, padding .4rem 1rem, margin-left .5rem) used on both <button> and RouterLink. Header user-menu links use ink-soft colour; Log out is a button styled as underlined text link (scoped in App.vue). Primary identity link .who is bold ink, underline on hover only.
conventions.focus: Global :focus-visible 3px solid --marker-red, offset 2px. Component-specific: .pick:focus-within (AvatarUpload, CoverUpload), VinylDisc .vinyl:focus-visible, CrateBox .scene:focus-visible .crate-label, RatingInput .star:has(:focus-visible). No outline:none resets found in base.css.
conventions.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) in RecordStage and VinylDisc; viewTransitions.ts checks it.
conventions.header_current: App.vue: <header class=masthead> (centered, double bottom border) with RouterLink .sign 'Frisson' (display font, marker-red, text-shadow), p.tagline, nav.user-menu aria-label=Account (conditional on session.loaded). Second nav in LibraryToolbar.vue (aria-label=View: Crates/List, plus Edit crates and '+ Add a record' .btn) rendered inside LibraryView and CrateView, not in App header. App.test.ts selects 'nav.user-menu' by class.
conventions.prettier: semi false, singleQuote, printWidth 100, trailingComma all; .prettierignore: dist, coverage, package-lock.json, .shipyard. Scripts: format, format:check.
conventions.eslint: Flat config: eslint-plugin-vue flat/essential, vue-ts recommended, prettier skip-formatting. Script: lint (eslint .).
conventions.editorconfig: utf-8, lf, 2-space, final newline, trim trailing ws (not md).
conventions.vscode: Prettier format on save, eslint fixAll, recommended extensions Volar/ESLint/Prettier/EditorConfig.

files: docs/adr/0001-0005 (stack, native TS, deployment, user accounts, user profiles)
documentation.header_navigation: No doc describes the header, masthead or navigation. ADRs and README are silent. SPEC tree lists views as CrateView, AlbumView, AddAlbumView (outdated vs actual).
documentation.visual_style: SPEC.md section 5 line ~102: '90s feel: paper/cardboard textures, price-tag stickers (rating), marker-style labels, a light grain overlay, a pixel or typewriter display font.' documentation.accessibility: SPEC line ~104: full keyboard navigation, prefers-reduced-motion respected, real buttons behind 3D effects.
